observations.behavior: Replaces payload-based signing with timestamp-based signing; adds signedAt and createdAt parameters; removes payload hash; adds stale signature and unknown source checks; updates counter and rejection reasons.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks that the signed timestamp and the consumer's received created_at are within a 5-minute window, billing the batch if the signature is stale. This protects against replay and clock skew while allowing consumer lag and DLQ replays.

observations.behavior: Adds SIGNED_AT_PATTERN and SIGNED_AT constant; removes payload hash; updates signature format to include signedAt; adds signedAt parameter to computeSignature; updates signInternalLogs to accept signedAt and convert to epoch seconds.
observations.posthog_connection: Parses the v1 signature to extract the signed timestamp and checks it against the supplied createdAt. This replaces the payload-dependent signature, which could not be reconstructed by the consumer.
